results.title: Portland City Council To Discuss Moda Center Renovations
results.description: The next step in negotiations between the city of Portland and the Trail Blazers regarding renovations to the Moda Center will take place at a meeting of city councilors Thursday morning, writes Vasili Varlamos of KATU in Portland.

results.title: Alexandrova collapses on court amid 34C heat
results.description: World number 19 Ekaterina Alexandrova collapsed on court and had to retire from her first-round match at the Memphis Classic due to high temperatures. Russian Alexandrova, the number one seed, was trailing 7-6 (7-2), 4-6, 5-4 against 16-year-old compatriot Kristina Liutova in a match where temperatures reached 34C. results.title: ‘The 49ers Screwed This Thing Up’ — NFL Insider Argues San Francisco ‘Mishandled’ Kyle Shanahan’s Car Crash
results.description: NFL training camps are starting up across the country, but instead of leading his team’s sessions for what would be his 10th season, San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan is out of commission. The 46-year-old is currently recovering from a serious car accident that occurred on July 14.
